subject.title: build(deps): bump github.com/steipete/commander from 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 in /apps/swabble in the swift-deps group across 1 directory

question: Should this bot bump wait for compatible released AXorcist and Peekaboo tags, or may OpenClaw pin unreleased upstream revisions to adopt Commander 0.2.3 now?
rationale: The released graph is incompatible, while the observed compatible AXorcist manifest exists only on its unreleased branch; CI cannot choose the repository’s dependency policy.

options.title: Wait for released graph
options.body: Defer the bump until tagged AXorcist and Peekaboo releases support Commander 0.2.3, then update the full graph together.

options.title: Use unreleased revisions
options.body: Pin compatible upstream commits now and explicitly accept the maintenance and validation cost of unreleased dependencies.

recommendation.title: Wait for released graph
recommendation.body: Defer the bump until tagged AXorcist and Peekaboo releases support Commander 0.2.3, then update the full graph together.

likelyOwner.reason: He is connected to the OpenClaw Swift package graph and owns the upstream dependency family needed to release or approve the compatible path.
